text: Assumption: The thread safety of to_ullong during concurrent read access is analogous to to_uint64t — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The thread safety of to_ullong during concurrent read access is analogous to to_uint64t — is this correct?
norm: the thread safety of to_ullong during concurrent read access is analogous to to_uint64t
assumption: The thread safety of to_ullong during concurrent read access is analogous to to_uint64t.
rationale: to_ullong is const noexcept, and to_uint64t is specified as a thread-safe alias according to SWS_CORE_01739.
